title: Executive Center
description: The whole agency at a glance: clients, revenue, delivery, team, marketing and sales.

tile.projection: On pace for {value} by period end

active_clients.name: Active clients
active_clients.definition: Clients with a package covering the last day of the period (or today, for a period still running).
active_clients.formula: count(clients with a package period covering the day)

new_clients.name: New clients
new_clients.definition: Clients whose first-ever package starts in the period.

churned_clients.name: Churned clients
churned_clients.definition: Clients whose last package ended in the period with no later package.
churned_clients.formula: count(last package end ∈ period, end < today)

revenue.name: Revenue
revenue.definition: Recurring package revenue recognized in the period: each package's monthly price spread over the days it covers.
revenue.formula: Σ monthly price × 12 ÷ 365 × days covered in the period

retention_rate.name: Retention
retention_rate.definition: Share of clients active on the first day of the period who are still active on its last day.
retention_rate.formula: active at end and at start ÷ active at start

top5_share.name: Top-5 client share
top5_share.definition: Share of the period's revenue that comes from the five largest clients. One client above 30% is flagged as a concentration risk.

revenue_per_hour.name: Revenue per hour
revenue_per_hour.definition: Package revenue of the period divided by the hours the team logged — a profitability proxy.

clv.name: Client lifetime value
clv.definition: Average monthly revenue per active client over the last 12 months × average client tenure in months.

extra_requests.name: Extra requests
extra_requests.definition: Requests submitted in the period outside the package allowance (billable extras).

avg_health.name: Average client health
avg_health.definition: Mean health score (0–100) of all clients, from the same penalty score as the operations dashboard.

requests_submitted.name: Requests submitted
requests_submitted.definition: Requests submitted by clients in the period.

turnaround_median.name: Turnaround (median)
turnaround_median.definition: Median days from submission to delivery, for requests delivered in the period.

turnaround_p90.name: Turnaround (P90)
turnaround_p90.definition: 90% of requests delivered in the period took this many days or fewer.

on_time_rate.name: On-time delivery
on_time_rate.definition: Of requests submitted in the period and delivered with a due date, the share delivered by the end of the due day — the SLA monitor's resolution compliance.
on_time_rate.formula: delivered by due ÷ delivered with a due date

sla_compliance.name: SLA compliance
sla_compliance.definition: Of requests submitted in the period whose reply target has passed or been answered, the share answered in time — the SLA monitor's response compliance.

revision_rounds.name: Revision rounds
revision_rounds.definition: Average rounds of changes per deliverable approved in the period.
revision_rounds.formula: mean(revision rounds of deliverables approved ∈ period)

first_time_approval.name: First-time approval
first_time_approval.definition: Share of deliverables approved in the period without any revision round.

approval_wait.name: Client approval wait
approval_wait.definition: Median days between sending a version to the client and the client's decision, for decisions in the period.

backlog_open.name: Open backlog
backlog_open.definition: Requests submitted and not yet delivered, closed, cancelled or rejected (today).

backlog_aged.name: Aged backlog
backlog_aged.definition: Open requests submitted more than 14 days ago.

utilization.name: Team utilization
utilization.definition: Hours logged by department members ÷ their available hours (hours per week × working days ÷ 5, minus holidays and time off) — the capacity planner's capacity.

task_on_time_rate.name: Tasks on time
task_on_time_rate.definition: Of tasks completed in the period that had a due date, the share completed on or before it.
task_on_time_rate.formula: completed by due ÷ completed with a due date

overloaded_departments.name: Over-allocated departments
overloaded_departments.definition: Departments whose demand exceeds capacity in at least one of the next four weeks (capacity planning, including weighted pipeline).
overloaded_departments.formula: count(departments with an 'over' week in the next 4)

ad_spend.name: Ad spend managed
ad_spend.definition: Total spend across all clients' campaigns in the period.

conversions.name: Conversions
conversions.definition: Conversions reported by the ad platforms in the period.

cpl.name: Cost per lead
cpl.definition: Spend ÷ leads reported by the ad platforms.

roas.name: Blended ROAS
roas.definition: Revenue attributed by the ad platforms ÷ spend.

campaigns_at_risk.name: Campaigns at risk
campaigns_at_risk.definition: Active campaigns whose pacing health is at risk or off track — the campaign analysis' health (today).
campaigns_at_risk.formula: count(active ∧ health is at risk or off track)

leads_new.name: New leads
leads_new.definition: Leads created in the period (merged and deleted leads excluded).

win_rate.name: Win rate
win_rate.definition: Deals won ÷ deals won or lost in the period — the sales dashboard's win rate.

sales_cycle.name: Sales cycle
sales_cycle.definition: Average days from creating a deal to winning it, for deals won in the period (the sales dashboard's definition).

avg_deal_size.name: Average deal size
avg_deal_size.definition: Average value of deals won in the period.

bookings.name: Bookings
bookings.definition: Value of deals won in the period.
bookings.formula: Σ value of deals won ∈ period

lead_response.name: Lead response time
lead_response.definition: Median hours from a lead's creation to the first activity on it, for leads created in the period.

open_risks.name: Open risks
open_risks.definition: Items in the risk register today: at-risk clients, SLA breaches, overdue deliverables, over-allocated departments, revenue concentration, expiring integrations and the AI budget.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.emptyBody: No risks, stuck deals, off-pace campaigns or over-used packages right now.

targets.title: KPI targets
targets.description: Yearly or quarterly targets the Executive Center measures progress against. Amounts are pro-rated over the days a period covers; rates use the quarter's target, else the year's.
targets.hint: Leave a cell empty for no target. Percentages are entered as 0–100; ROAS as a multiple (e.g. 3.5); revenue in SAR.
targets.readOnly: You can view the targets; changing them needs the schedule or organization permission.
targets.invalid: Enter a number of zero or more.
